summary.text: Quasi-grandmaster sits between master and grandmaster on the attainment ladder. Holders are often elites among rank six Gu Immortals.

claims.text: Realm on a path climbs a fixed ladder from ordinary to supreme grandmaster. Quasi-grandmaster is the quasi step between master and grandmaster. It is not one of the five main levels (ordinary, master, grandmaster, great grandmaster, and supreme grandmaster); those main levels are the rungs the quasi steps sit between.

Fang Yuan as a refinement path quasi-grandmaster is one step away from grandmaster, but that one step is very far away and needs great accumulation to break through. His previous-life and current-life accumulations forced refinement path from master up to this quasi step, and raising it further stays hard when refinement is only a side path.

Dream realms can close the same gap quickly. Feng Jin Huang reaches refinement path quasi-grandmaster by exploring dream realms after learning the true use of dream wings Immortal Gu, catching up to a height Fang Yuan spent five hundred years of accumulation to approach.
Those who possess quasi-grandmaster attainment are often elites among rank six Gu Immortals. Above them, grandmaster is rarer still and mostly held by rank seven Gu Immortals after long accumulation.

Chi Shang as a formation path grandmaster and Fang Yuan as a formation path quasi-grandmaster are close enough that formation answers can still be adjusted between them. If the gap were too high, modification would be impossible.
The full ladder is on Attainment. Neighboring steps include master attainment and grandmaster attainment. Dao marks and how they relate to attainment are on Dao Marks and Attainment.
